note: Receiver for AWS interruption events. An EventBridge rule (infra/template.yaml) matches the three detail-types below from source aws.ec2 and delivers them to the SQS queue ms-router-aws-events; the router consumes that queue and posts each message here (or EventBridge can target an API destination directly). The body is the unmodified EventBridge event. instance-id is mapped to a fleet GPU through the worker's registration (fleet entry extra.instanceId or the worker's heartbeat). Effects are listed in detailTypes below. A Capacity Block event names a capacity reservation, mapped to the fleet GPUs running in it. Requires X-MS-Internal-Key when INTERNAL_API_KEY is set.

capacityReservationInterruption.detail_type: EC2 Capacity Reservation Instance Interruption Warning

detailTypes.Capacity Block Expiration Warning: sent 40 minutes before the block ends; instances start terminating 10 minutes later: reclaim with a 600 s warning (docs: capacity-blocks-monitor)

keyNote: AWS's Capacity Block samples spell the key detail_type; Spot samples use detail-type. The receiver accepts both.
